nodes.description: Public constant uint256 PRICE_MULTIPLIER = 1e10 scaling factor used to convert 8-decimal Chainlink prices to 18 decimals.
State variable oracle of type AggregatorInterface holding the external Chainlink aggregator address.
ChainlinkOracleAdapter constructor that stores the provided aggregator address into state.
External view read() that fetches the oracle answer and applies the price multiplier.
Constructor parameter _oracle of type AggregatorInterface.
Local uint256 oracleOutput holding the coerced oracle answer.
External call oracle.latestAnswer() to the untrusted aggregator contract returning int256.
SafeMath multiplication of oracleOutput by PRICE_MULTIPLIER.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure function performing checked multiplication.
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Local uint256 c holding the product a * b inside SafeMath.mul.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure checked division.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure checked subtraction.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure checked addition.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure modulo with zero check.
AggregatorInterface.latestAnswer() external view returning int256 oracle value.
AggregatorInterface.latestTimestamp() external view returning uint256 update timestamp.
AggregatorInterface.latestRound() external view returning the latest round id.
AggregatorInterface.getAnswer(uint256 roundId) external view returning int256.
AggregatorInterface.getTimestamp(uint256 roundId) external view returning uint256.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _oracle is stored into state variable oracle.
Constructor writes the aggregator address into the oracle state variable.
read() executes the external call oracle.latestAnswer().
read() invokes the external aggregator function latestAnswer() on an untrusted contract address.
Result of oracle.latestAnswer() is coerced to uint256 and stored in local oracleOutput.
oracleOutput is an operand of the multiplication with PRICE_MULTIPLIER.
PRICE_MULTIPLIER constant is an operand of the multiplication in read().
read() performs the scaled price multiplication before returning.
read() delegates the multiplication to SafeMath.mul.
Multiplied oracle value is returned by read().
Parameter a is an operand of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b is an operand of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a participates in the product c = a * b.
Parameter b participates in the product c = a * b.
Local c is the checked product returned by SafeMath.mul.
